name: Imlie
description: All Imlie wanted was to create a name for herself in the city. But upon her arrival, she finds herself caught in the middle of Aditya and Malini's love story.

videos.title: Meet Imlie
videos.overview: Imlie, a smart young girl, aims to give her mother a good life.

videos.title: Imlie Wins an Award
videos.overview: Malini apologises to Aditya after her mother humiliates him. Later, Imlie is filled with joy when she gets a prestigious award from her school.

videos.title: Imlie, Aditya Cross Paths
videos.overview: Imlie and Aditya run into each other when the latter's bike rams into the vehicle she is travelling in. At home, Malini's mother speaks ill of Aditya.

videos.title: Satyakaam Consoles Imlie
videos.overview: Malini is esctatic to receive Aditya's call and reminds him of their parents' meeting. In Pagdandia, Satyakaam finds a dejected Imlie and consoles her.

videos.title: Imlie Takes a Stand!
videos.overview: Imlie enjoys herself at the village fair and takes a stand against Aditya's views. While Malini's mother expresses her disapproval, Aditya follows Satyakaam.

videos.title: Aditya Is Taken Hostage
videos.overview: Suspecting foulplay, Satyakaam and his men take Aditya hostage. Meanwhile, Malini's parents reach Aditya's house to discuss their marriage dates.

videos.title: Aditya Is in Danger
videos.overview: Imlie helps Satyakaam and his men kidnap Aditya while Malini is distraught over her mother's decision. Later, Satyakaam holds Aditya at gunpoint!

videos.title: Aditya Interviews Satyakaam
videos.overview: Aditya manages to gain Satyakaam's trust and interviews him to learn about his fight. Later, Malini feels a rift forming between Aditya and her.

videos.title: Imlie, Aditya's Wild Ride
videos.overview: Imlie arrives with a strange choice of a ride for Aditya and the two enjoy in the rain. Meanwhile, Malini's mother fixes the date of her engagement.

videos.title: Aditya Gets Into Trouble
videos.overview: Aditya decides to take shelter with Imlie in a hut during the storm but gets into trouble with the villagers. Elsewhere, Aditya's family puts forth a heartfelt request to Anu.

videos.title: A Tough Choice for Aditya
videos.overview: Amma says that if Aditya wants the villagers to spare his life, he has to marry Imlie. Meanwhile, Aditya's family worries upon not being able to contact him.

videos.title: Aditya Marries Imlie
videos.overview: Aditya is forced to marry Imlie at gunpoint while the latter's mother reveals the truth about Aditya to her friend. Meanwhile, Malini worries for Aditya.

videos.title: A Strange Predicament For Imlie
videos.overview: Aditya tells Imlie that they will go their separate ways on reaching Delhi while she makes a promise to him. Later, Amma sends a spy to follow Aditya and Imlie.

videos.title: Imlie Gets a Home
videos.overview: Aditya brings Imlie to an N.G.O but soon realises that it won't be safe for her. Later, Imlie meets Aditya's family and is welcomes into their home.

videos.title: Aditya Rebukes Imlie
videos.overview: Aditya tries to tell Malini the truth but fails when he sees her joyous mood. Later, Aditya's mother stands by Imlie when he loses his cool at her.

videos.title: Imlie Recieves Praise
videos.overview: Imlie garners praise from Aditya's mother for cleverly fixing his phone. Later, Malini has an argument with Anu while Aditya has a close call.

videos.title: Malini Meets Imlie
videos.overview: Malini visits Aditya and meets Imlie, but she gets confused as to why Aditya didn't tell her about bringing her with him. Later, Imlie comes face to face with her father.

videos.title: Is Imlie in Danger?
videos.overview: While Malini's father praises Imlie, Anu suspects that she stole the jewelry. Later, the family are shocked to find Imlie lying unconscious.

videos.title: Imlie is Hurt
videos.overview: Aditya’s family plays a trick on Imlie and his mother makes her try out Malini’s ring. Later, Aditya makes a comment hurting Imlie.

videos.title: Aditya Confesses His Fears
videos.overview: While Imlie is overwhelmed by Aditya's gesture, he tells her about his fear of getting exposed and breaking Malini's heart. Later, Satyakaam learns about Imlie.

videos.title: Satyakaam Fumes in Anger
videos.overview: Aditya meets Malini's grandmother while Imlie and his family celebrate Shiv Puja. At Pagdandia, a furious Satyakaam decides to confront Amma.

videos.title: Malini, Aditya's Romantic Dinner
videos.overview: Aditya refuses to listen to anyone in his family and announces to send Imlie back to the village. Later, Aditya has a romantic dinner with Malini at her house.

videos.title: Imlie Is in Danger
videos.overview: Anu rebukes Aditya's family after they arrive at the venue. While Malini's pre-wedding rituals commence, Imlie lands in grave trouble.

videos.title: Aditya Saves Imlie
videos.overview: Aditya waits for the cops to save the girls but steps in to rescue Imlie himself as the cops don't show up quickly. Later, Imlie spots a shocking painting at Malini's house.

videos.title: Imlie Is Devastated
videos.overview: Imlie is devastated after witnessing Malini and Aditya's engagement. Later, Malini finds Aditya's camera in her house.

videos.title: Good News for Aditya
videos.overview: As Aditya decides to take Imlie back to Pagdandia, his mother gives him the good news of his marriage date being fixed. Later, Aditya meets Malini to tell her the truth.

videos.title: Dev Meets Imlie
videos.overview: Dev visits Imlie in the kitchen and asks her about her mother. Meanwhile, Aditya decides to come clean to Malini.

videos.title: Aditya Is Rattled
videos.overview: Aditya is shocked when he receives a call from Satyakaam and blames Imlie for sharing his number. He later hires a new servant for the house.

videos.title: Imlie Creates a Scene
videos.overview: Imlie tries to save herself from Aditya's rage. While Aditya's mother tries to pacify him, Imlie creates a huge scene at the market.

videos.title: Aditya Hurts Imlie
videos.overview: Aditya taunts Anu about her snobbish nature while Imlie faces a perilous situation. Later, Aditya's harsh words leave Imlie shattered.

videos.title: Aditya Insults Imlie
videos.overview: A prank meant for Imlie backfires when Malini gets trapped in a room. While Anu berates the Tripathis, Aditya's words hurt Imlie.

videos.title: Malini's Request to Imlie
videos.overview: Imlie consoles Rupali who feels dejected at her fate. At the function, Malini requests Imlie to apply mehendi on her hands, leaving everyone stunned.

videos.title: Malini's Mehendi Ceremony
videos.overview: Shashank executes his cunning plan as he spikes Imlie's drink. While Malini and Aditya get close, an intoxicated Imlie does the unthinkable.

videos.title: Dejection Strikes Imlie
videos.overview: Anu creates a huge scene while Malini confronts Shashank about spiking the drinks. Later, Imlie is filled with despair about Aditya's wedding with Malini.

videos.title: Aditya Loses His Cool
videos.overview: Malini's grand haldi ceremony commences in great fervor. While Anu grows emotional about her departure, Aditya lashes out at Imlie.

videos.title: Imlie Recalls the Past
videos.overview: Imlie grows dejected about returning to her village leaving Aditya and his family. While Aditya and Malini's wedding day arrives, Imlie recalls the past.

videos.title: Imlie's Firm Decision
videos.overview: At the wedding, Anu asks Imlie to inform her if she ever finds her father. Afterwards, Imlie decides not to leave the Tripathis and confronts Aditya about it.

videos.title: Imlie Makes a Sacrifice
videos.overview: Imlie helps out Malini when her veil gets torn. Later, Shashank tries to misbehave with Imlie. Can she escape his evil plan?

videos.title: Imlie Hides the Truth
videos.overview: A heartbroken Imlie watches Aditya get married to Malini. While the police arrive at the wedding venue to arrest Satyakaam, Imlie hides a grave truth from Meethi.

videos.title: Imlie Is Shattered
videos.overview: Imlie is left shattered after getting separated from Meethi while Aditya takes an unexpected decision. Later, Malini grows emotional at her Vidai ceremony.

videos.title: Satyakaam Consoles Meethi
videos.overview: Satyakaam consoles Meethi while Anu grows concerned about Malini. Meanwhile, Malini and Aditya's post-wedding ceremony commences on a grand note.

videos.title: Malini Pours Her Heart Out
videos.overview: Malini shares her thoughts with Aditya about Anu and Dev's toxic relationship. While Imlie attempts to do Malini's makeover, Aditya does the unthinkable.

videos.title: Anu Grows Suspicious
videos.overview: While Dev asks Imlie about Meethi and Satyakaam, Anu grows suspicious. On their first night, Aditya and Malini spend quality time.

videos.title: Malini's Benevolent Act
videos.overview: Malini confronts Aditya about his disgraceful behaviour towards Imlie. While Imlie's health deteriorates, Malini's decision leaves everyone shocked.

videos.title: Imlie's Act of Kindness
videos.overview: Malini requests Aditya to apologise to Imlie for his behaviour. Later, they find Imlie trying to help an old lady in the hospital with her funny antics.

videos.title: Malini's Benevolent Offer
videos.overview: Malini asks Aditya to do something romantic, but he refuses playfully. She later offers to get Imlie admitted to the college she teaches at.

videos.title: Imlie Beams with Anticipation
videos.overview: Anu rebukes Aditya as he chooses to go to Pagdandiya while Imlie grows excited to meet Meethi. Later, Aditya takes a firm decision about Imlie.

videos.title: Imlie Bids Goodbye
videos.overview: Imlie gets emotional as she bids goodbye to Aditya's family. When Malini finds Imlie's Mangalsutra in her room, Aditya denies any knowledge of it.

videos.title: Imlie, Aditya Part Ways
videos.overview: Aditya offers money to Imlie before leaving. Later, Satyakaam questions Imlie about Aditya.

videos.title: Imlie's Shocking Request
videos.overview: Meethi and Satyakaam have a huge misunderstanding about Imlie and Aditya's marriage. Later, Imlie puts forth a shocking request before Aditya.

videos.title: Aditya's Stern Decision
videos.overview: Unaware of the reality, the family performs Imlie and Aditya's wedding rituals. While Malini tries to pacify Anu, Aditya takes a stern decision.

videos.title: Aditya Feels Irritated
videos.overview: Malini celebrates her Pehli Rasoi ceremony with the family. Later, she calls up Aditya who feels irritated and trapped in Pagdandia.

videos.title: Aditya, Imlie Lock Horns
videos.overview: On the occasion of Makar Sankranti, Imlie challenges Aditya to fly a kite against her. Later, Satyakaam's men hold Aditya at gunpoint.

videos.title: Aditya Feels Uncomfortable
videos.overview: Aditya feels annoyed with Imlie as she talks to her friends about her Sasural. Meanwhile, Rupali grows uneasy and lashes out at her family.

videos.title: Imlie Defends Herself
videos.overview: Aditya hurls accusations at Imlie for showing keen interest for their first night. While she defends herself, Aditya takes a shocking decision.
